nom: belif Aqua Bomb Hydrating Jelly Cleanser

avis.texte: This is a great cleanser for sensitive skin. It leaves your skin looking brighter, but sometimes you need to double cleanse because it is so gentle.
I've been looking for a gentle yet effective cleanser and this is the one!!!

I pre-cleansed with mh normal cleanser to remove any makeup, then I decided to try this product to see how it felt on my skin… IMMEDIATELY my skin started burning everywhere I applied this cleanser. I followed up by promptly, washing it off with my regular cleanser and it stopped burning. Sucks cause I loved the face cream the one time I tried it.
This feels so good and cleans all of the makeup and sunscreen off of my face!
Cleans without stripping layers off of my skin. Also I don't need to use very much at a time.
The foam is rich, the scent is fresh, it doesn't dry out your face after washing, and it rinses off easily.
My all time favorite cleanser. I've tried others but always go back to belief jelly cleanser! Love how it foams up!

avis.titre: Great for dry, acne prone skin
avis.texte: My skin has become increasingly dry yet acne prone after the birth of my son, so I have been trying to find ways to soothe and hydrate it without clogging my pores. This cleanser has done wonders at keeping my face so much more hydrated and soft without losing the deep cleanse that comes with other strong cleansers. I intend to switch from my longstanding cleanser to this one, so I definitely plan to purchase again!

The only facial cleanser I use!! I like to work it into a creamy micro foam and gently lather my face and neck in it, it feels SO NICE and hydrating! This size bottle will probably last me half a year which is pretty substantial. Really, really good stuff.
I love this face cleaner. Very gentle on my face. Leaves face feeling clean, soft.
I love this face wash! Not overly drying, and my skin feels so clean and fresh. Great for sensitive skin.
I have been using this facewash for about 3/4 years now and it is so good on my super sensitive skin
This cleanser leaves my skin squeaky clean and feelinf refreshed. It smells amazing too.
It smells nice and the foam feels soft on the skin. It doesn't dry my skin after I washed my face. I like the fact that it's foamy and smell super good

I have dry and kinda sensitive skin. While this is very hydrating it burns and makes me break out. This cleanser does have a smell, I personally love the smell, it is just not for sensitive skin because it's a little strong. I recommend for those without sensitive skin.

avis.titre: One of my favorite face washes
avis.texte: This face wash is gentle and foaming without drying you out. It's my go-to for morning and evening (the second cleanse), It's gentle enough to use around the eye area too. A little goes a long way, too, so it lasts.
I love this aqua bomb hydrating jelly cleaner. It work very well on my skin and make my skin is very clean and smooth. Highly recommended
Great for dry skin as it is super hydrating. Great if you have acne, helped clear some breakthrough bumps.
I use to remove makeup and works amazing! Can be difficult to remove water proof makeup.

avis.titre: i would not buy this product again
avis.texte: It was really hydrating and all, but in my experience, it caused me to break out in pimples and break out in hives. I have eczema as well, so that could have contributed to the breakout, but I have never had a breakout so severe in my life.
I really liked this face wash. It was refreshing, smelled great, and felt like it really cleansed my skin. It also made my face feel very soft and moisturized!

The cleanser and moisturizer is soooo good for my combination skin. Not drying at all but not greasy or thick. Leaves no residue. Just perfect skin. I'm never using anything else I think I will buy it!

This jelly cleansing cleanser is the best cleanser I've had to take off my make up it lathers really good. It smells good too as a really distinct good smell and it just does a great job when I'm taking off my make up after a long day and I totally recommend.

It does the job in removing your make up. However, I feel like it leaves my skin dry. How I can relate to is how when you shower and use shampoo, that texture feeling without putting conditioner is how it feels on my face, but once I put moisturizer I'm good to go.

avis.titre: Make skin clean, soft and hydrate, removing make up easily
avis.texte: This Cleanser works for my whole face in just small dot. I try to use 2 ways : 1/ My rountine cleaning face: Oil for make up removal and then cleanser 2/ No oil make up removal , only just cleanser The result is the same, this cleanser can remove my make up without oil make up removal. I will use this cleaser for my clean skin routine. One more plus point, this cleanser smell really good and fresh.

I really enjoy this cleanser! It's a very cooling, gel texture that foams up when water is added. I feel that it thoroughly cleans my face and does not leave any residue or greasy feeling behind. I think I will really like this product for summer when my skin is not as dry, as I do feel that the product does leave my skin feeling a bit taut. But, this has and can be easily fixed with a good moisturizer. I have and will continue to use this product!

I will definitely be repurchasing. This elderly millennials' skin is dry and usually I have reddened cheeks (which I *try* to cover up with foundation). I've been using this face wash, along with their Aqua Bomb moisturizer and toner for about two weeks now, and my cheeks have become visibly less red (yay!) and my skin isn't flaky and irritated looking on my forehead anymore. I'm floored to finally have found a combo of products that helps because the redness and dryness makes me so self conscious. You don't need much of any of the products listed above- a little goes a LONG way. I have sensitive skin currently (thinking my skin barrier is damaged), and I experienced zero irritation. The face wash instantly made my skin feel moisturized, but not the strange warm and occluded feeling I've experienced with other similar jelly/oily type face washes. It seems to help make my filaments/pores less visible on my nose, and feels clean after rinsing. It's the perfect mix of clean but moisturized I've been looking for. If you've got dry skin due to health conditions (like me), or age, definitely try this line out. I have gone through so many brands and wasted a lot of money trying to find something that actually delivers on its claims.

I was hesitant about this cleanser as I'm still figuring the difference between gel and gelly/jelly. My skin is combo and prone to acne flare-ups and flakiness. This cleanser felt so nice putting on, but I did go overboard with too much product. A little goes a long way with this one and made my skin feel clean and hydrated and looked brighter after just a week.
I find this jelly cleanser very gentle on skin, it leaves a fresh and smooth skin even after the first use. Like the scent, would recommend it

avis.titre: Smooth and creamy cleanser I'm obsessed with
avis.texte: When I received this package, I was impressed. It comes in a clear plastic box, explaining the product and its benefits. This is a gel-to-foam cleanser, with lady's mantle and herbal formula to relax while cleansing. It also contains glycerin for hydration and amino acids to remove makeup and impurities. It is great for nearly all skin types, but dry isn't listed. I love that this also contains no mineral oils. While first using this cleaner, I was surprised by the lavender-smelling formula. The gel consistency was light and transitioned pleasantly to a smooth, rich foam. Not a light foam, but one that was dense and effective for cleansing. My face felt so smooth, soft and my pores looked smaller. I noticed zero irritation to my eczema. After a week of use, my makeup applies more smoothly and looks less cakey. This makes for my new favorite part of my shower routine.
My skin is ultra sensitive, so I loved that this was such a smooth cleanser that didn't irritate it at all! No breakouts is a win for me plus the added bonus of no makeup left on my skin?! Win, win.

I absolutely love the smell of this face wash. I used to hate washing my face, and now it's the highlight of my day. That being said, may not be the safest option for those with sensitive skin. It's light enough to not irritate my sensitive skin, but could easily trigger others. As far as quality, it is such a smooth formula and it lathers easily. Not too thin, nor too heavy. I would argue it cleans just as well as any other jelly formulas, but is also a bit easier to use. A small amount goes longer than you think. My skin is also left refreshed after washing. I don't feel like it strips my skin of moisture, but is not moisturizing in itself. The formula really is smooth and lathers nicely, and the smell alone will have me coming back for this face wash.

I love this product! I've never used a jelly face wash before and I am happy this is my first experience. A little goes a long way, it's not irritating and it feels good! I have sensitive combination skin and this didn't break me out at all. I am also prone to acne when trying out new skincare products and this didn't cause me to breakout.

I absolutely love this facial wash! It's everything that I was looking for. It's moisturizing, cleansing and hydrating all at once! Allowed me to replace my neutrogena hydro boost cleaner. The smell is also amazing and not overwhelming, perfect balance!! Has my face feeling smooth and refreshed after. And the size of the bottle is generous. Design is super cute

avis.titre: This product is a must to buy every time
avis.texte: This jelly cleanser is amazing!! So great at removing makeup. Great to use as an everyday cleanser. It's so hydrating and so soft. Foams so great to wash. Leaves my skin feeling so clean and soft.

I love this cleanser, it is very nice. It is similar to others I've used in the past. I would definitely use a makeup wipe first if you are using this as your only cleansing option but overall it's great.
I've tried and repurchased many belif products throughout the years. This cleanser is gentle but effective. Won't dry out your skin and will get rid of most makeup and impurities. Highly recommend!
I absolutely love this cleanser for removing makeup. My face feels very clean afterwards. Only thing i don't like is it can make my skin feel very drying afterwards

avis.titre: This is a really good product
avis.texte: This product is an excellent jelly cleanser. It got all my makeup off and I wear like 10 pounds most the time. I was super surprised when I had waterproof mascara on the day, and it just immediately removed. It definitely would buy again.

I'm usually all over the foamy and super sudsy cleansers but I love the thickness of this jelly cleanser! I've had really dry skin since/after my pregnancy and this cleanser helps me feel squeaky clean without feeling stripped or dry. It has a light, fresh soapy fragrance. Paired with the aqua bomb moisturizer I feel soft and hydrated!

I love how clean this product makes my face feel. I have combo skin, and it's not too drying on my dry areas and it doesn't leave my face oily on my oily spots. I do wish they didn't go so far with the fragrance- it is VERY strong. It doesn't smell bad, I just prefer no fragrance.

avis.titre: I AM MOST DEFINATLY BUYING THIS PRODUCT
avis.texte: It's very smooth cleanser and doesn't leave your face feeling dry after! Leave your face feeling very smooth and your pours feeling refreshed. Smells very nice!
I love how gentle in affective this product is. After using this face wash, my face feels fresh and clean but not stripped. It has a light scent and foam's up very well. A little goes a long way.

I received this Aqua Bomb Hydrating Jelly Cleanser for free from BzzAgent and Belif in exchange for my honest review. I very much do enjoy using Aqua Bomb Hydrating Jelly Cleanser and this one for cleanser really does be an enjoyable and cleansing and refreshing. Makes the cleansing feel good.Doesn't dry my face out, but feels so clean afterwards.This cleanser provides a refreshing burst of hydration while cleansing the skin. Highly recommend this very delightful and pleasing cleanser to my days and nights.

Belif has a lot of holy grail skincare items and this jelly cleanser sets the bar high! It does a good job of removing my makeup and it feels very cooling and soothing on my face. It doesn't have any strong fragrance smell, which is good. High quality cleanser and does the job, I recommend you try this product!

I was gifted this product to try and post my honest review. This product is really good at removing stubborn makeup and I did enjoy the feeling of it on my skin. I think a little goes a long way as well so I see this being a long lasting product on my counter. The only slight disadvantage of this product is the smell -it smells good but I have sensitive skin and am worried the fragrance may cause a reaction. Used the product consistently for about 1.5 weeks though and have had no issues thus far! overall very happy with the product and excited to continue using

The texture, scent, and effectiveness of this cleanser makes it a total win. Thanks Aquabomb for sending me the Hydrating Jelly Cleanser for free to review. I loved how my skin feels after using it. It seems to was off quickly and removes my makeup well.
I love using this face cleansing jelly ! It lathers really well, smells great and gets all of my makeup off ! * I was given this product for free in exchange for an honest review*

This cleanser is amazing! I have sensitive skin and after using that my skin is clean but not dry, super moisturized. My skin feels silky soft and clean but not stripped of moisture. The scent is amazing, very fresh & clean. Recommend!!
I really like this face cleanser because it's not stripping but really cleans my skin well. The jelly texture is nice too and it doesn't have a strong scent. The packaging is nice as well.

This cleanser is amazing, I love the smell and it lathers very well. It's powerful enough to remove my makeup but doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped or like there is a film on it. I have dry/ normal skin and it works great for me. Left my skin hydrated after use and a great canvas for my skincare.

This is one of my favorite cleanser. It is lightly scented and washes off impurities very well. Love the design of the bottle. It's good as an everyday wash. May need to double cleanse if wearing makeup.

avis.titre: Aqua Bomb Jelly Cleanser for the WIN .
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product ! It has a light citrusy scent that smells wonderful. My skin feels really nice too. My face feels hydrated and soft . Usually I have issues with my skin drying out but this has worked great . I love how a little goes a long way . Definitely adding to my collection of everyday use !!
I like this cleanser! It felt like it stripped my skin a little because it is a slightly foaming cleanser, but I like it and would consider purchasing it again.

I received this product from bzzagent in exchange for my honest review. This cleanser was a pretty basic cleanser in terms of a first cleanse. It was very gentle, hydrating and didn't feel stripping. It did have a slight fragrance so if you're sensitive to that I would probably avoid it. Im giving it four stars only because If you are prone to wearing heavy makeup you would probably need to use a cleansing balm prior to this, because even though this product claims it "removes makeup" I found it again was a very gentle cleanser and wouldn't remove a full face in one cleanse. Overall it's a nice face wash, my skin did not feel stripped after washing and it didn't cause any irritation or breakouts!

avis.titre: jelly cleanser product? first time i know about it
avis.texte: This is my first time experiencing a jelly cleanser. It's very strange and feels surprising when applied to the face. BzzAgent brought me Aqua Bomb Hydrating Jelly Cleaner just in time for the cold weather. It will help my face feel less rough and rough. thank you

I was previously using oil of olay face wash and I purchased a belief gift box that included this cleanser and Aqua bomb moisturizer. Today i puchased the full size since I finished the travel size. I like how the wash makes my face feel, clean and refreshed. I feel a minty tingle as well, really great for these hot summer days. I highly recommend.

My boyfriend has eczema and acne on his face, and this is the only facewash that hasn't dried his skin out even more, and he's tried a lot. I also have dry skin and haven't had dry patches since I started using this.
The texture is literally like jelly. Its easy to use and wash off, no residue. After washing it off, my face is so extremely soft. Love this stuff!!

I enjoy this as a follow up to a cleansing balm. However, please DO NOT put this near or on your eyes. It will irritate them. Other than that, it leaves my skin clean, hydrated and smells really nice.

avis.titre: Gentle, effective, great smell, long lasting.￼
avis.texte: Ihave very sensitive skin and most cleansers are too harsh for me. I was a little worried about this due to the slight cooling effect, but it has worked out. I love the smell and find it immensely refreshing. I bought this in March of last year and I'm still using the same bottle. I was out of town a few times and used one of the trial sizes then, but still despite the fact that this is a little bit expensive, it certainly lasted and worth the money. I do occasionally need to wash my face twice but I do not consider that much of a drawback considering how little needs to be used and how gentle it is.￼ I also occasionally use a stronger cleanser if my face feels extra grubby.￼ It's a fantastic product and I would be interested if Belif had a shower gel/body cleanser.￼

I usually LOVE belief moisturizers and think they are amazing so when I ran into ulta to grab this face wash I had high hopes. Ever since I've been using this products I'm red, dried out all around my t zone and flaking, and breaking out on my forehead. Really wanted to love this because I love the consistency of this product but it made me skin look awful.

I love how cleansing and foamy this is! It gently washes all the dirt off my face without stripping it dry. It also rinses easily in hard water or in hotels that use water softener. I will forever use this product
I have never had such a bad experience with a cleanser before. I used it once and it immediately made my skin red, itchy, and dry. This is definitely NOT "for all skin types" as they advertise.
Perfect cleanser for all skin types . Really lathers up and removes makeup including eye makeup . Nice smell and lasts long . Gentle cleanser

I have been using this face wash along with Belif True Aqua Bomb consistently for well over a year now. I had used these products off and on 5 years ago or so and loved them. My skin was loving it..until recently. Something in the new batches of these products is different. After purchasing new in both those items, my skin has become red, inflamed, itchy and just over all ticked off. I don't know what happened. They must have changed ingredients slightly, I'm not certain. I am certain that I will no longer be purchasing Belif products and will be switching back over to Murad.

avis.titre: Are the samples a different formula??
avis.texte: I had a sample of this and absolutely loved it. So much so that I later purchased the full size bottle. Was so disappointed that the full size item seemed to be a completely different formula and even smelled different. It also doesn't do much when it comes to acne or any breakouts. The sample I had smelled amazing and slightly citrusy, left a refreshing and clean feeling. The full size product smells like nothing and doesn't feel refreshing or clean. Incredibly underwhelming and disappointed with this. I wanted to love it so bad. Won't be purchasing again especially for the huge price tag on this. Not worth the money in the slightest.
Does not leave a clean feeling on the face after a wash. Felt like using Irish Springs, instead of Dove on your face if you know what I mean.

I didn't believe it at first when I was recommended this product that with a smaller amount it would go a long way but it truly does. I noticed my face isn't dry even when I wash it more than once when I'm doing facials or trying to remove waterproof/difficult makeup.

avis.titre: I have tried many different cleansers, and always come back
avis.texte: This product makes my skin feel so clean. i have dry, sensitive, and acne prone skin. it doesn't dry out my skin whatsoever. it doesn't irritate my skin whatsoever. and it actually has helped me prevent breakouts. i am so in love. the only thing is that she is a bit pricey, but to me she's fully worth it.

I adore belif skincare was super excited to try this jelly cleanser! It did not disappoint, and I even got my husband using it because he loves the scent. The scent is not harsh by the way and has not caused either of us irritation. I have dry skin and this cleanses without drying me out too much. I love the consistency and follow up with my belif aqua bomb moisturizer!
I used this daily for two weeks and ended up with a bumpy rash on one side of my face.

I have tried many face washes and the Aqua Bomb works perfectly for my skin. It does not strip away the oils so much that my face feels tight afterward. It has a light citrus-y scent that is not too heavy. I do not break out from using it.

avis.titre: Perfect for those with sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have had this product for more than six months and can honestly say it has changed my skin! The texture is great and it doesn't have a very strong fragrance. I have fairly sensitive skin and have found this to be one of the only products that doesn't burn. Everyone is different but at least for me, this is the perfect cleanser!

My routine is: - (NIGHT only) Cleanse w/ DHC Oil Cleanser first - Wash w/ this product (2x/daily) - (day) Thayers Witch Hazel Toner (night) Ordinary Glycolic Acid Toner - Ordinary Caffeine Eye Cream - Acne Spot Treatment - Peach&Lily's Peach Slices Citrus-Honey Aqua Glow - Problem Solution Moisturizer I have COMBO-OILY skin, and I sleep on my stomach sometimes and having your face smushed by a pillow is NOT good for the skin at all. This product is one of the only face cleansers that don't overly dry out my face, treats my sensitive skin well, and helps prevent more breakouts. It has a light orange scent and lathers well. When I use my hands to wash, I always make sure to work jelly cleansers like this into a good lather first before washing my face, I feel like the foam penetrates the skin a little more and breaks down leftover oil cleanser, dirt and grime, and sebum. When I use Aqua Bomb cleanser with my Clarisonic cleansing brush, my face feels super clean afterwards, like I FEEL the clean on the skin and it's just so nice especially after a long day at work.
This cleanser lathers and foams but doesn't dry out my skin. I love this cleanser!
I got this cleanser as a gift and I genuinely love it. Works perfect for my combo/oily skin. My skin feels fresh, clean, and so soft after using!

I have sensitive combination skin (dry skin on my cheeks with oily t-zone). This is by far my favorite facial cleanser. I purchased this originally in a Belif kit when I was trying out the the true cream aqua bomb and moisturizing eye bomb (which I also LOVE and have been using along with this cleanser for the past 2 years). This cleanser leaves me face feeling soft and clean without stripping the moisture and never irritates my skin.

I love this cleanser. It is expensive, so I'm not sure how often I will buy it. But, a little goes a long way. A dime sized amount is all you need to clean your face. And it's great at getting all of your makeup off, including eye makeup.
One of my all time favorite cleansers. Non-irritating to use on my sensitive skin twice a day. Still removes makeup without a lot of scrubbing.

I received a sample of this and tried it for about a week for the first time. A little bit goes a long way and it's gentle on the skin. For a foaming cleanser it doesn't strip the skin and leave it feeling tight. It has a long list of ingredients including many plant extracts/oils. Has a pleasant scent.

For some reason, my skin was getting really dry. This cleanser leaves my face feeling soft without feeling even the tiniest bit oily. I'm not sure how that magic happens, but I like it! It's gentle and nourishing at the same time.

avis.titre: one of the best cleanser i have ever used.
avis.texte: I am 62 years old and have always taken great care of my skin. I always start with my age because really, I don't care how this works for a twenty-something who thinks they have wrinkles. I wish Ulta would include age of the reviewer in their criteria. I have always used some very high-end skin care, but I'm always looking for something different. I do not believe in cosmetic procedures, but I do I believe that great diet, sunscreen and great skincare are the key to having beautiful skin at any age. That being said, this is a marvellous cleanser. You need a tiny amount in your hand which works into a beautiful lather with water, and cleanses the face beautifully, including makeup, without stripping. The scent is great. It washes off clean. it is not drying in the least, and leaves your face feeling wonderful. Fresh. I currently use IT Cosmetics, but several of the products that I really like, I cannot get at at Ulta, and I have to order them off of IT which is a pain. I have a fantastic Ulta in my town, and I want to support my local store. So, I decided to branch out into another line that my local was recommended to me. I have also tried their moisture bomb eye cream, I have been using it during the day only, and after a week of using it during the day, I can really see a difference in the fine lines around the outside of my eyes. I still use the it confidence in an eye cream at night, but will most likely switch to this completely when I am done. I would encourage all of y

I live in a desert climate and have always had very dry skin. During quarantine I haven't been as diligent with using my normal skincare routine every day, and was starting to see little breakouts all across my forehead that were not going away. I tried a charcoal soap which just dried out my skin more, causing it to produce more oil and breakout even worse. An esthetician suggested a more moisturizing cleanser, so i found this and within 2-3 days the breakouts started clearing and my skin was much smoother. I didn't change any other products I was using, so I think this did the trick. It doesn't feel like it adds moisture to my skin, but it also doesn't feel like it's drying it out. It seems to just balance it. I use a pea sized amount to wash my face at night and then follow with my regular nighttime moisturizer.

Belief may not use animal ingredients but they do sell in China where they are required to test products on animals. Used to be one of my favorite brands. If the company changes its policies I would probably support them again.

Love this cleanser. I do double cleanse but there has been times that i only use this and it really does get all my make up and gunk off my face. In the past i have gone between this and the Clinique face wash but i keep coming back to this i don't feel like i over strips my skin like the clinique can tend to. I will continue to repurchase and stick to it.

This cleanser is amazing! I typically use Fresh and have for awhile due to my skin being so sensitive but I came across the face wash in a value set with the lotion. It smells fresh, a little goes a long way and doesn't make my skin feel tight or itchy after. I have picky sensitive combination skin. Using this product, the toner and the lotion has made me skin feel soft, and not oily all day. Definitely glad I purchased it and will continue using it!
So many cleansers I use just leave my face feeling super stripped of hydration. This cleanser works great and makes my skin feel dewy! I have oily skin and still had great results with this
Clean feeling without drying. Takes all makeup off easily. Subtle, pleasant scent. Expensive, but does the jobs well. Doesn't irritate. It's my new favorite!
I use this as my second cleanse after I use an AHA balm cleanser. It has cheaper control my oily skin well and clear me up very fast. It's incredibly gentle. This is my second time purchasing!

Kinda wish I didnt buy it since the stores are closed and I cant return it right now.. blame the rona' it's a basic foaming cleanser. I didnt find it very moisturizing, it doesn't have active ingredients like vitamin c or aha's or anything so if you want an expensive basic foaming cleaner then by all means try this out.

I have combination skin and this cleanser is perfect! Leaves my skin soft, smooth, and supple. It doesn't strip away my skin's moisture. It has a very light, pleasant smell. I love washing my face with this cleanser!

I tried a sample of the jelly cleanser and immediately knew that it would be my new facial cleanser! my face feels so clean and smooth. it really foams up which I love, and does not leave my face feeling dry. definitely my new holy grail!

avis.titre: Like the cleanser name, it's the bomb!
avis.texte: This cleanser gently removes your makeup and after you rinse it out, you are left with your face feeling hydrating and clean! This product is definitely a re-buyer for me!

avis.titre: oh! so that's what a high-quality cleanser feels like!
avis.texte: I'm really glad Ulta is carrying this product. Up until I got this last month, I really only used drugstore cleansers. They usually left my face feeling clean, but also like my face had been stripped of all it's natural oils. This is different. After I used it for the first time I was amazed that I felt both clean and hydrated! It's a win for me.
